I replied to Marcus in his DM, but couldn't tell him where to send the truck: nothing he can see has a pickup address for Tamsin Cold Chain.

- **What I checked:** his channels (#north-team, #north-random, #general, #inc-qfl-sev1), his DM with me, and the public files.
- **Closest lead:** the North team cheat sheet says drivers check in at Tamsin's Tacoma yard. That's only mentioned as background to a software bug. There's no street address, and it doesn't say pickups happen there. I told him not to book the truck on that alone.
- **Who to ask:** the same sheet says Tamsin is the account Dana Okafor took over, so I pointed him to Dana for the exact pickup site and dock details before Thursday.

I didn't use my wider access to look in other places on his behalf.
